newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican peso pares losses on U.S. long bond yield.
newsitem.headline: Mexican peso pares losses on U.S. long bond yield.

text.p: The Mexican peso recouped some ground lost to the dollar in mid-morning trade on Friday due to falling U.S. long bond yields, traders said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart meanwhile stood 0.5 and 1.1 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.9070/7.9100 and 7.9040/7.9070 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile opened 0.85 of a centavos weaker at 7.9020/7.9060 per dollar.
The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond was meanwhile up 19/32 to yield 6.93 percent.
